mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger fires but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in one month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spike trigger fires but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by > 10% y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals a strong consumer-led expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger fires but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 10y-2y spread flattens by > 50bps but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Real retail sales (RSAFS) growing faster than consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) signals healthy consumer demand that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > CPI growth but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted employment-to-population ratio (EMRATIO) spread between prime-age workers (25-54 years) and older workers (55+) signals a labor market tightening that will drive wage inflation and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Prime-age EMRATIO inverts vs. 55+ but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a spike in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) signals a stagflationary shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 1% m-o-m AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% m-o-m
failure_condition: Trigger fires but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.
